I got one visit after the custody order was issued because he’s on drugs. He refuses to let me see my child and I filed the contempt in the state of Iowa, and they still keep denying my contempt and are not allowing me to see my child. This is ruined my family, my life they’ve harassed me they’ve hacked into my phones. They drove me out of the state of Iowa and now I live in a different state because I could no longer live there anymore after all of this psychological warfare.
